name: non_analyzed_speakers
description: Assistant and family speech is excluded from risk detection, even when it mentions money.

payload.speaker: caller
payload.text: Hi Mom, how was your day?

payload.speaker: family
payload.text: Don't send any money right now, and don't tell anyone your bank account number.

payload.speaker: assistant
payload.text: I will not buy gift cards now, and I cannot keep this secret.
